response.sql: SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) as fraction_of_total FROM income i INNER JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id INNER JOIN major maj ON mem.link_to_major = maj.major_id GROUP BY maj.college ORDER BY maj.college;

assumptions.assumption: If any major has a NULL college value, it is included in the results as a row with college=NULL. The phrase 'for each college of those majors' could be read as excluding NULL values (since NULL is not a college), but the request does not explicitly specify this behavior.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'for each college' should exclude NULL colleges (only reporting actual colleges), add a WHERE clause to filter them out.
alternatives.sql: SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) as fraction_of_total FROM income i INNER JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id INNER JOIN major maj ON mem.link_to_major = maj.major_id WHERE maj.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY maj.college ORDER BY maj.college;
